summary: Official Vizianagaram district Revenue and Survey, Settlements and Land Records custodians were identified, and Andhra Pradesh Bhunaksha/MeeBhoomi services were discovered. Bounded requests did not produce anonymous Vizianagaram parcel ID-plus-polygon data; no sample GeoJSON is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Telugu discovery queries and actual result URLs are recorded in city-11293-vizianagaram.json. First-party district pages establish local registry custody and public service existence, but not open citywide geometry coverage.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GET requests loaded the official district revenue and survey pages. The Telugu route redirected. Bhunaksha timed out after 20 seconds and MeeBhoomi did not return a usable bounded response. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request or TLS disablement was used.
